title: security: rbac v2 - KMS region residency audit hardening and additional logging
author: Ava Martinez
description: Context: We observed gaps in audit visibility for KMS region-residency decisions and edge cases where RBAC v2 allowed ambiguous KMS selections when region pinning policies applied. This PR hardens audit logging for KMS region pinning, adds explicit audit trail fields for residency decisions, and tightens RBAC v2 enforcement so policy evaluation includes residency constraints earlier in the request path. Motivation: improve compliance evidence for SOC2/GDPR audits and reduce operator ambiguity during failure/fallback scenarios. Changes: 1) Add audit_event.residency_reason and audit_event.kms_selection fields and populate these at the point of policy evaluation and enforcement. 2) Wire residency enforcement into the RBAC v2 policy engine so decisions are recorded before any KMS crypto operations are initiated. 3) Introduce a KMS residency validation step in the private-installer that warns on misconfigured region pinning. 4) Enhance middleware to tag requests with residency metadata that is included in structured logs and traces. 5) Tests and migration script to backfill audit_event records with best-effort residency_reason for recent events. Checklist: - [x] Schema migration and backfill script included - [x] Unit and integration tests for policy evaluation branch - [x] E2E test in perf-canary to assert no latency regression >5% for common paths - [x] Docs updates for RBAC v2 policy fields and admin controls - [x] Manual review by security and compliance teams Migration notes: includes a lightweight DB migration adding two nullable columns to audit_event. Backfill is timeboxed and runs in small batches by default. Rollout plan: deploy to staging, enable enhanced logging flag, run backfill, monitor for errors and latency; gradually enable enforcement flag in canary regions; full rollout after 48 hours with no regressions. Rollback plan: enforcement is behind a feature flag; rollback toggles enforcement off and leaves audit log fields intact. Tests: unit tests for policy engine, integration tests for KMS selection, manual compliance checklist validated by security SME. Impact: no breaking API changes, but operators should plan for a 5-10% increase in audit log volume. See release_notes for admin action items.

release_notes: Hardening: Added structured audit fields for KMS region residency and stronger RBAC v2 enforcement. Admins should review increased audit log retention and schedule the included backfill. No customer-facing API changes.
security_impact: Improves compliance evidence and reduces incorrect KMS selections when region pinning policies are active. Minor increase in audit log volume and storage costs.
notes_for_ops: After deployment enable the feature flag 'residency_enforcement' in a canary region, run the backfill with the dry-run mode first, and monitor residency_backfill_progress and kms_residency_enforcement_failures metrics. The migration can be run online and is reversible by disabling enforcement flag.
